methods.captured_demand: Huff gravity: P_ij ∝ A_j / d_ij^λ over viable H3 cells; demand weight D_i = population_density × income_index, else opportunity_score.
methods.coverage: Share of total demand weight D_i within radius_m of any site (haversine).
methods.circle_overlap: Lens overlap of equal circles, cross-check only; not sales diversion.
methods.cannibalization: MODELLED share of prior Huff capture lost at an existing site when candidates are added.
methods.incremental_vs_shifted: incremental_demand: Huff capture on cells inside the candidate MAX_REACH_M envelope outside every existing site reach; shifted_from_existing: capture on shared-reach cells reallocated from existing sites.
methods.max_reach_m: Modelling assumption: cells with no site within MAX_REACH_M (haversine × detour) are excluded from Huff allocation; reach_sensitivity varies 800 / 1200 / 2000 m at default decay.
methods.distance_decay: Modelling assumption: Huff weight ∝ A / d^λ; decay_sensitivity varies λ at default reach.

data_sources.grid: area_cells (INSEE IRIS demographics, OSM competitive/digital/footfall proxies, DVF rent)
